rounds.learn: if runs code only when something is true. The if line ends with a colon, and the code under it moves in 4 spaces. else runs when it is not true.

rounds.learn: == asks if two things are equal. One = stores a value. Two == compare.
rounds.code:
word = "open sesame"
if word [[==]] "open sesame":
    print("come in")
[[else]]:
    print("nope")
rounds.say: come in. Two == compared, and they matched.
